newSays: A lesson: the class goes through this story together. You press “Next”, everyone votes on their own device, you see the votes at once.

host.noConfig: This lesson has no story — create it again from a tower.
host.noVote: No vote right now — a question, a fork or chapters open one.
host.thresholdsSay: Only a hint for you: above the first value explain and move on, between them let neighbours talk and vote again, below the second go back to the slide.

advice.move-on: Most know it — explain briefly and move on.
advice.discuss: The class is split — let neighbours discuss, then vote again.
advice.back: Few know it — go back to the slide.

showVotes.after: The class, after the vote closes

student.onlyBoard: This question is answered on the board.

task.hostSays: Each student sees it on their map; it ticks itself off when their progress reaches the goal.

menu.title: Map settings
menu.leadSays: Above towers, paths and forks: “Lead here” and “Assign”. Your own answers in a lesson do not count for your progress.
menu.learnSays: Normal learning — your answers count for your progress.

map.leadSays: Start a lesson here: the class goes this story together

lead.title: Start a lesson
lead.says: “{name}” with {area}: you lead, the class votes on their devices.
lead.trails: Stories of the lesson (one after another)
lead.sequence: Ticked stories run one after another; each ends at its tower.

assign.title: Assign to the class
assign.says: For {area} — it ticks itself off from each student’s progress.

round.none: No questions here — continue with the next part.

plan.notLead: Only someone who leads this class can plan its lessons.
plan.title: Lessons of {name}
plan.lede: Plan a lesson: choose where it starts and which tower it leads to — the way between comes by itself (the same as „Lead me here"). Then leave out, add and move parts, save the plan and start it with one click.
plan.noSuch: This plan does not exist (any more).
plan.midPath: Start in the middle of a path
plan.pickTargetSays: Choose the tower the lesson should lead to.
plan.routeSays: The way for a class that starts here. Untick what you leave out, add what is missing, move with the arrows.
plan.alreadyKnown: From this start the class already has „{name}" — choose an earlier start or another target.
plan.towerHow: How the class goes through the tower

warnSays.one: {count} part stands before what it needs — allowed, but check it.
warnSays.other: {count} parts stand before what they need — allowed, but check them.

plan.deleteSays: The lessons that were held with it stay.
plan.fromMap: Plan a longer lesson to here
